Dr Aneel Kumar
Melbourne City Clinic
98 Brick Road
West Melbourne 3007

Dear Dr Kumar,
Re: Mr. Henry Mathews, aged 24 years

I am writing to update you on Mr. Mathews, who has been diagnosed with secondary syphilis for your
kind follow-up.                                                                                             Comment [OET1]: . Treatment has been
                                                                                                            commenced and he would need your further
On 25/01/2022, Mr. Mathews presented with fever, sore throat, headache, tiredness and joint pain.
Additionally, he complained of rash on his trunk, limbs and genitals. On examination, his temperature and
pulse were found to be high at 101 and 90, respectively. In addition, pinkish symmetrical non-itchy         Comment [OET2]: a
maculopapular rash was noticed on his trunk and extremeties as well as painful swollen fingers.             Comment [OET3]: extremities along with
Consequently, blood tests were ordered.

Mr. Mathews’s test results revealed an abnormal CBC with Hb of 10.5, WBC of 14000, neutrophils of 86
and platelets of 103. Further investigations showed positive RPR and TPPA., and Treponema pallidum was      Comment [OET4]: .
visualized on microscopy. Therefore, Mr. Mathew was commenced on doxycycline and paracetamol. He            Comment [OET5]: give dosages
was advised to stop sexual activity until his rash resolves completely and to inform about any new severe   Comment [OET6]: resolved
symptoms at once. Please note the Local Health Department will be reported.
                                                                                                            Comment [OET7]: informed about him

Based on the above, your further care of Mr. Mathew would be highly appreciated including counselling       Comment [OET8]: . It should include
for practising sex safely, following treatment plan and tracing all possible contacts while preserving      Comment [OET9]: the
confidentiality. Mr. Mathew will need to be vaccinated against hepatitis B and C. His recent contact
tracing with confidentiality would also be required.

Should you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
